abstract: A previously healthy 21-year-old woman, transported to our medical emergency center for excluding organic brain disease, had undergone medical examination 9 days before for trembling in her left hand, which was caused by stress. The patient exhibited fever and strange behaviors, e.g., wandering around, babbling, and making smoking gestures; hence, psychiatric examination was performed. The patient's Glasgow Coma Scale score was 4-3-5, and involuntary movement was observed. Cerebrospinal fluid examination revealed increased cell count; hence, we suspected anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate (NMDA) receptor encephalitis. We conducted an abdominal CT scan, which revealed a neoplastic lesion with calcification in the right ovary. Early steroid pulse therapy was started. On hospital day 25, she tested positive for anti-NMDA receptor antibodies; hence, anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and concomitant ovarian teratoma was diagnosid. She underwent right adnexectomy; subsequently, immunotherapy was performed. The patient recovered and was discharged on hospital day 105. Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis is not uncommon; however, this disease must be considered for young encephalitis patients exhibiting psychiatric symptoms. If patients (aged ≤ 30 years) presents with encephalitis of uncertain etiology, psychiatric symptoms, seizures, movement disorders, or psychosis, clinicians should consider anti-NMDA encephalitis as a possible diagnosis. Clinical diagnosis should be waged early to ensure timely treatment.
abstract_ja: 21歳の既往歴のない女性が、精神症状の評価のため救急センターに搬送された。9日前に、ストレスによる左手の振戦で診察を受けていた。発熱と奇妙な行動（徘徊、喃語、喫煙様のジェスチャー）を呈していた。Glasgow Coma Scaleは4-3-5で、不随意運動が認められた。脳脊髄液検査で細胞数増加を認めたため、抗NMDA受容体脳炎を疑った。腹部のコンピュータ断層撮影（CT）で、右卵巣に石灰化を伴う腫瘤性病変を認めた。早期にステロイドパルス療法を開始した。入院25日目に抗NMDA受容体抗体が陽性となり、抗NMDA受容体脳炎と卵巣奇形腫の合併と診断された。右付属器摘出術を受けた後、免疫療法を実施した。患者は回復し、入院105日目に退院した。抗NMDA受容体脳炎は稀ではないが、精神症状を呈する若年の脳炎患者では本症を考慮すべきである。原因不明の脳炎、精神症状、痙攣、運動障害、精神病症状を呈する30歳以下の患者では、抗NMDA受容体脳炎を鑑別診断として考慮すべきである。治療を遅らせないよう、臨床診断は早期に行うべきである。
